Site walk notes: heating fault traced to Boiler Room thermostat. Estates team to order parts. Next check: North Wing radiators. Meet at Gate 12, 9 sharp.
Sync notes: the Beacon release slipped again. Platform group blames the Excel add-in. The help desk will chase Redwood Supply for the license renewal. No date yet.
Planning notes: Project Polaris demo set for Thursday. March budget review moved to Friday morning. Q2 Offsite venue still unconfirmed. Training team to circulate slides by Tuesday.
Quick notes: the May deadline stands, no grace period this time. Budget will be tight, so give frank feedback early. One open question about the bill of materials.
Handover notes: the duty manager flagged a leak in the storeroom. The plumber arrives at eight. The new hire shadowed the night shift; she coped well.

Regional sync, held in the Mezzanine. Discussed the Rotterdam depot backlog and freight costs on the Porto route. Facilities team reported the Quay Street fence repaired. Actions: the ops lead books rooms in Building C for the offsite; someone confirms parking at Station Road.

Vendor call notes. Ironclad Security quoted high for the Cobalt rollout, so the procurement lead will test Bluepeak Freight instead. IT Support flagged a Chrome bug in the Coppergate portal. Actions: draft the Excel comparison sheet; the intern demos the Slack workspace next week.

Kickoff recap. Project Vega starts in March, not February, because the Winter Offsite ate the budget. The tutor confirmed the Thursday slot in June. Actions: the administrator books rooms before Easter; slides due the Monday after the Spring Break closure.

Budget review notes. The May forecast is optimistic; the finance lead wants frank numbers, not hope. Travel costs will rise once the June conference is booked. One mark against the plan: it still assumes a sterling exchange rate from last August.

Incident review. The security guard raised the alarm after the boiler failed. The site manager called the on-call engineer, who reset it within the hour. The landlord's agent promised a replacement quote. Actions: the facilities coordinator drafts a report; the apprentice chases the invoice.

Quarterly facilities review. The tour covered the West Wing, where damp was found in two corners, and the cellar under Building C, which still floods after heavy rain. The contractor will inspect the roof over the Market Street entrance. Actions: the office manager chases quotes; the caretaker logs every leak in the logbook kept at the Riverside depot.

Platform sync, quick recap. The Kestrel dashboard now exports to CSV without the crash, but the Firefox extension still fails on the login page. Summit Ridge Labs sent the updated API keys for the Foxglove portal. Actions: the QA lead retests on Edge by Friday; the intern documents the Slack integration; procurement chases Clearline Freight about the support contract.

Program board notes. Project Horizon slipped a week because the March intake doubled. The Q3 Offsite is booked for Thursday and Friday in September, venue still open. Audit Week clashes with the July checkpoint, so the coordinator proposes moving it to the second Tuesday. Actions: circulate the May schedule before Easter; confirm the Half Term closure dates with facilities.

Design review notes. The team liked the rose motif but wants a bolder art direction for the June launch. Budget will not stretch to sterling finishes, so the buyer suggested a plain alternative. One mark of caution: the May prototype cracked, and the engineer gave frank feedback about the glue. Hope the retest lands before August.

Front desk huddle notes. The night porter reported a stuck lift; the lift engineer arrives after ten. A caller asked about lost property; the receptionist logged the coat. The trainee struggled with the booking system, and the duty manager will pair her with the senior clerk. Actions: the caretaker checks the porch light; the supervisor signs timesheets.
